items.titleZh: 皮亚斯特里谈巴库一号弯锁死：「确实让我措手不及」，本有望登台
items.summaryZh: 皮亚斯特里开局在一号弯超越勒克莱尔升至第二，并一度顶住维斯塔潘和哈贾尔；第一次安全车重启后被维斯塔潘超越，第二次重启后又遭哈贾尔施压，下一圈防守一号弯时出现双轮锁死，冲进缓冲区后名次大跌，最终列第14。「上半场非常鼓舞人心，之后就崩了……我得弄清楚锁死是怎么回事，因为它确实让我措手不及。」（来源：Formula 1）
items.originalTitle: ‘Certainly took me by surprise’ – Oscar Piastri reflects on Azerbaijan GP result after mistake
detailZh: 迈凯伦在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上过得十分艰难，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和兰多·诺里斯都没有拿到积分。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里承认，那次可能让他失去阿塞拜疆大奖赛领奖台的锁死「确实让我措手不及」；这一天迈凯伦一分未得。
在环绕巴库历史街区的51圈比赛中，皮亚斯特里前半程表现强势，开局在第一个弯角超越夏尔·勒克莱尔升至第二。
随后这位迈凯伦车手顶住了来势汹汹的马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔，两位红牛车手在比赛初段都展现出强劲速度。
在两次安全车中的第一次期间进站后，皮亚斯特里仍保持第二，但重启时没能守住维斯塔潘，跌至第三。
第二次安全车因第一个弯角发生的一起碰撞而出动，迈凯伦队友兰多·诺里斯卷入其中；重启时皮亚斯特里再次遭到身后的压力，这次来自哈贾尔。
他起初挡住了这位法国车手，但在下一圈进入一号弯时采取防守路线，结果出现双轮锁死，冲进缓冲区，名次大幅下滑。
「就是失望。显然，我觉得第一段和比赛前半程非常鼓舞人心，但从那以后就有点崩了。」最终列第14名的皮亚斯特里说。
「锁死的事我需要弄清楚发生了什么，因为它确实让我措手不及。我得去看一看，但最后没拿到成绩，显然非常令人失望。」
皮亚斯特里2026赛季至今过得很艰难，只登上过两次领奖台，最近一次还是5月的迈阿密站；而诺里斯在此前五站比赛中赢了两场。
尽管错失成绩，皮亚斯特里仍对自己在巴库整个周末的表现感到鼓舞，因为他重新回到了车阵前列。
「我觉得等尘埃落定，这个周末会有很多积极的东西。」他说。
「我觉得昨天的排位不错，总体上我感觉舒服多了——也许不是更舒服，而是对我需要怎么驾驭这台车有了更明确的方向。
「积极的方面有很多，只是最后没有积分、没有奖杯，显然会很难受。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: McLaren suffered a difficult Azerbaijan Grand Prix as neither Oscar Piastri or Lando Norris scored points.

Oscar Piastri admits that the lock-up which potentially cost the Australian driver a podium in the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "certainly took me by surprise", on a day where McLaren failed to score a point.
Piastri had enjoyed a strong first half to the 51-lap race around Baku's historic streets, overtaking Charles Leclerc for second through the opening corner.
The McLaren driver then held off the charging Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar as both Red Bull drivers showed strong pace early on.
Piastri maintained second when pitting under the first of two Safety Cars, but at the restart, he was unable to hold Verstappen behind and dropped to third.

A second Safety Car was called after a collision at the opening corner, involving McLaren team mate Lando Norris, and Piastri once again faced pressure from behind at the restart, this time from Hadjar.
Having initially rebuffed the Frenchman, Piastri went defensive into Turn 1 on the following lap, suffering a double lock-up that sent him into the run-off area and down the order.

"Just disappointed. Obviously I think the first stint and the first half of the race was very encouraging and then from there on, it kind of unravelled," said Piastri, who was eventually classified in P14.
"The lock-up I need to understand what happened because it certainly took me by surprise. I need to go and have a look, but obviously very disappointing not to have a result at the end."
Piastri has endured a difficult season so far in 2026, taking just two podiums with the last one coming at Miami in May, while Norris has taken two wins from the previous five races.
Despite missing out on the result, Piastri was encouraged by his performance over the weekend in Baku having been back towards the front of the field.
"I think once the dust settles there will be a lot of positives from this weekend," he said.
"I think Qualifying yesterday was good, I think in general I felt much more comfortable, well maybe not more comfortable but I've had more direction on what I need to do with the car.
"There's plenty of positives it just hurts obviously when you don't have any points or a trophy at the end."

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/certainly-took-me-by-surprise-piastri-reflects-on-azerbaijan-gp-result-after-mistake.6THrL3hQt1nTOMgRqVOfmf

皮亚斯特里本季仅两次登台，上一次还是5月迈阿密站；诺里斯近五站已赢两场

items.originalTitle: James Vowles hails Williams factory effort after major Baku F1 upgrade
items.summaryEn: Williams team principal James Vowles has praised the team's relentless factory effort to deliver a major upgrade package for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, despite the team only leaving the weekend with one point.
detailZh: 詹姆斯·沃尔斯盛赞威廉姆斯工厂为巴库一级方程式重大升级所做的努力
威廉姆斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛推出了重大升级套件
威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯盛赞位于格罗夫的车队工厂为阿塞拜疆大奖赛不懈努力、交付重大升级套件，尽管车队那个周末最终只带回了一个积分。
威廉姆斯携大幅升级抵达巴库城市赛道，升级包括两个全新底盘、一项大规模减重计划以及一套经过修改的空气动力学设置。
"首先也是最重要的，感谢所有日夜辛勤工作、让我们在本周末带来这套升级的人," 沃尔斯在一段 Instagram 视频中解释道。
"同时带来两个全新底盘、为整套赛车减掉大量重量，还附带一套空气动力学升级，并把这一切都运抵巴库，这绝非易事。
"我们几个月前就开始谈论这件事了，但真正看到它在本周末落地，感觉实在太棒了。"
这套升级套件在排位赛中展现了潜力，卡洛斯·塞恩斯成功晋级第三节排位赛（Q3），但正赛则更具挑战性。塞恩斯以第十名完赛拿到一个积分，不过截至本文撰写时，他正因涉嫌练习发车违规而接受调查。他的队友亚历克斯·阿尔本在第 31 圈发生撞车。
"你可以在排位赛中看到，我们能取得不错的成绩，但比赛的表现真的起起伏伏，在某些时候，比如和塞恩斯，我们实在无法找到排位赛里那样的性能," 沃尔斯继续说道。
"我认为我们在这方面已经有了一些方向，但塞恩斯为了那个积分战斗到最后一刻，干得漂亮。
"至于亚历克斯，真的很遗憾。他当时开得非常出色。一阵风从根本上导致他无法充分完成倒计时减速，结果撞上了护墙。这只是巴库这个因素，这是一条街道赛道，这类因素会受到相当严厉的惩罚。
"我们会把那辆车重建好，赶往下周在马来西亚举行的比赛。巴库是三连赛的第一站。但正如我所说，开局非常稳固，但我们还有工作要做。"
detailEn: James Vowles hails Williams factory effort after major Baku F1 upgrade
Williams introduced a major upgrade package at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix

Williams team principal James Vowles has praised the Grove outfit's relentless factory effort to deliver a major upgrade package for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, despite the team only walking away with one point from the weekend.
Williams arrived at the Baku City Circuit with a substantial update, which included two new chassis, an extensive weight-saving programme and a revised aerodynamic set-up.
"First and foremost, thank you to everyone who has been working diligently day and night to achieve the update that we brought here this weekend," Vowles explained in an Instagram video.
"It's no mean feat to bring two new chassis, take a large amount of weight out of a package, and an aerodynamic update at the same time, deliver all of that to Baku.
"And we started speaking about this a few months ago, but it's really fantastic to see it delivered here this weekend."

The upgraded package showed promise in qualifying with Carlos Sainz progressing to Q3, but the grand prix proved more challenging. Sainz managed to score one point with a 10th-place finish, although at the time of writing, he is under investigation for an alleged practice start infringement. His team-mate Alex Albon crashed on lap 31.

"You can see in qualifying, we're able to achieve a good result, but the race was really up and down, and at certain points, with Carlos, for example, we really couldn't find the performance that was there in qualifying," Vowles continued.
"I think we have some direction on that already, but well done to Carlos for fighting to the very end, for that point.

"With Alex, it's a real shame. He was driving incredibly well. A gust of wind fundamentally meant that he was unable to slow the countdown sufficiently and went into the wall. And that is just a factor of Baku, it's a street circuit, and these sorts of elements get punished quite hard.
"We'll get that car rebuilt for Malaysia, which is taking place [next week]. [Baku was] the first of a triple-header. But as I say, really solid start, but we have work to do."
keyPointsZh: 升级包包含两具新底盘
还包含一项大规模减重计划
空气动力学布局也经过修改
keyPointsEn: The upgrade package included two new chassis.
The team carried out an extensive weight-saving programme.
The aerodynamic set-up was also revised.

items.originalTitle: Why Max Verstappen says 0.196s Baku finish-line gap to George Russell is slightly misleading
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen missed out on his first win of the 2026 Formula 1 season at Baku, finishing just 0.196 seconds behind George Russell. Verstappen said after the race that the finish-line gap is slightly misleading.
detailZh: 为什么马克斯·维斯塔潘说巴库终点线上与乔治·拉塞尔之间0.196秒的差距有些误导性
维斯塔潘表示，实际差距足有一秒，并补充说即使排位赛没有出现引擎问题，胜利也会很难。不过，这是今年头几次之一，这位红牛车手确实享受了比赛过程
在巴库市街赛道上，拉塞尔排位赛后说的话变成了现实：这位梅赛德斯车手周五就曾预言，尽管维斯塔潘从第八位发车，他将是争夺胜利的最大威胁，而在巴库街道上激动人心的最后阶段，事实果然如此
维斯塔潘在终点线前仅以0.196秒之差错失了2026年一级方程式赛季的首场胜利，不过他赛后强调，实际差距比这个数字要略大一些
"当然，冲线时看起来很接近，但我觉得那更多是因为拉塞尔在15号弯黄旗时遇到了一点动力延迟问题"，维斯塔潘说道。
"所以如果你看最后一节比赛的话，差距一直是一秒左右，所以那大概也就是我们最终会取得的差距。"
这一说法也得到了拉塞尔本人的证实。在为博塔斯的事故松开油门后，梅赛德斯的动力单元没有立即给出他所期待的加速表现。
"黄旗出现时，我松开了动力，当我重新踩下油门时，涡轮没有压力，所以就没有动力"，这位梅赛德斯车手解释道。"马克斯差一点就在终点线上超过我了。那可就真的太可惜了，不过总的来说，这是一个难以置信的周末。"
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队；乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队
维斯塔潘认为，即使他从第一排发车，阿塞拜疆大奖赛的结果也会是一样的。
周五，这位四届世界冠军得出结论，红牛因为引擎问题搞砸了今年最好的夺冠机会，红牛“把大好机会浪费得一塌糊涂”；但24小时后，维斯塔潘认为比赛的收尾阶段大致还是会以同样的方式展开。
“我是说，昨天的情况就是这样。你遇到了问题，这意味着你必须从第八位发车。但我认为即使我从第二位发车，以乔治（拉塞尔）的节奏，想超过去也会非常困难。”这位荷兰车手承认。
“所以说，在第一段比赛里，我当然本可以跟得更紧一些。但之后你进站，你就排在第二了，那我们大概率还是会跑出一场同样的比赛，只是互相推着对方往前跑。”
维斯塔潘在2026年首次能够真正享受F1
不过，维斯塔潘确实表示，他很享受巴库比赛的收官阶段。考虑到现行技术规则的种种不足，这是他今年第一次真正感到享受的比赛之一。
“我得说，最后那几圈非常令人享受，因为轮胎衰退几乎可以忽略不计。我们一直全力推到终点，差距始终在一秒或一点一秒左右。这种感觉真好。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
维斯塔潘在这方面也冒了风险，如果不是为了可能的分站冠军，这些风险他或许根本不会去冒。他知道红牛——尤其是开启超车模式时——拥有惊人的极速，而梅赛德斯在巴库老城周围多弯的路段更快。
为了仍然能在这条F1赛历上最长的直道上给自己保留机会，并至少每圈都能追近一些差距，维斯塔潘尝试在最后几个弯角尽量“放开”路线。
“最后那段比赛很有趣。我还亲了几堵墙，不过那只是为了在巴库这里留下我的印记！”维斯塔潘笑着说。
“所以，是的，在这里总是非常有挑战性，无论是排位赛，还是现在比赛尾声阶段，都要全力以赴地推进。这当然伴随着风险，因为内线和外线都紧贴着某些护墙，但感觉很酷。”
detailEn: Why Max Verstappen says 0.196s Baku finish-line gap to George Russell is slightly misleading

Verstappen says the true margin was a full second and adds that victory would have been difficult even without the engine problem in qualifying. For one of the first times this year, however, the Red Bull driver did enjoy the racing

At the Baku City Circuit, the words Russell spoke after qualifying became reality: the Mercedes driver had already predicted on Friday that, despite starting eighth, Verstappen would pose the biggest threat for victory, and that proved to be the case in a thrilling finale around the streets of Baku.
Verstappen fell just 0.196 seconds short of his first victory of the 2026 Formula 1 season at the line, although he stressed afterwards that the actual gap was slightly larger than that.
"Of course, it looked close on the line, but I think that was more because George suffered from a little bit of boost lag in Turn 15 with the yellow flag", Verstappen said.
"So if you look at the last stint, it was always one second, so that’s probably also where we would have finished."
It is a theory that Russell himself also confirms. After lifting off for Valtteri Bottas’ crash, the Mercedes power unit did not immediately deliver the acceleration he was expecting.

"When the yellow flag came out, I lifted off the power and when I went back on, I had no turbo, so then I had no power”, the Mercedes driver explained. “Max almost got me at the line. That would have been a real shame, but all in all, it’s been an incredible weekend."
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
Verstappen also believes the outcome of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix would have been the same had he started from the front row.

On Friday, the four-time world champion concluded that Red Bull had "done a great job messing up" its best chance of a victory this year with the engine problem, but 24 hours later Verstappen believes the closing stages of the race would have played out in more or less the same way.

"I mean, that’s what happened yesterday. You have a problem and that means that you have to start from P8. But I think even if I started second, I think with the pace of George, it would have been very hard to pass", the Dutchman admitted.
"So maybe I could have followed him a bit better in that first stint, of course. But then you box, you’re second, and then we would probably have done the same race, just pushing each other along."
Verstappen able to enjoy F1 for one of the first times in 2026
Verstappen does, however, say that he enjoyed the closing stages in Baku, which, given all the shortcomings of the technical regulations, was one of the first times he had done so all year.
"I have to say that those last laps were very enjoyable because there was barely any deg, really. We were just pushing to the end and the gap was always, like, one second or 1.1. That was nice."
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

Verstappen also took risks in that respect, risks he perhaps would not have taken for any result other than a potential race win. He knew Red Bull – especially with overtake mode – had an impressive amount of top speed, while Mercedes was faster in the twisty section around Baku’s old town.
To still give himself a chance on the longest straight of the F1 calendar and at least close the gap again on every lap, Verstappen tried to ‘open up’ the final few corners as much as possible.
"That last stint was fun. I kissed a few walls as well, but that was just to leave my mark here in Baku!", Verstappen smiled.

"So, yeah, it’s always very challenging around here, qualifying and now at the end of the race as well, just pushing flat out. That comes with risk, of course, being close to certain walls on the inside and the outside, but it was cool."
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔在周五排位后就已预言，尽管维斯塔潘第八位发车，仍将是争夺胜利的最大威胁。
两人冲线差距仅为0.196秒，维斯塔潘认为这个数字略具误导性。
keyPointsEn: The finish-line gap was only 0.196 seconds, which Verstappen said is slightly misleading.

items.titleZh: 巴库小红牛队友相撞未被处罚 劳森表示不解
items.summaryZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛中，小红牛车队的林德布拉德锁死刹车撞上队友劳森，导致后者赛车底板破损退赛，但干事在事发20分钟内判定无需进一步行动。
items.originalTitle: Shock inaction over Baku's other F1 team-mate clash explained
items.summaryEn: At the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad locked up and crashed into team-mate Liam Lawson, destroying Lawson's floor and race, yet the stewards dismissed the incident as requiring no further action within 20 minutes.
detailZh: 小红牛车队内部在F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛上发生的碰撞导致利亚姆·劳森退赛，令人意外的是，这次事故被裁定无需进一步处理。
弗兰科·科拉平托因撞上他的阿尔卑斯车队队友皮埃尔·加斯利以及兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦，被处以10秒时间罚时（转换为马来西亚大奖赛退后五个发车位），但干事们决定不对发生在他们身后的那次碰撞采取行动。
当奥康和劳森在一号弯刹车区并排行驶时，林德布拉德最终锁死了刹车，撞上了姐妹车的劳森，在后者赛车底盘上撞出了一个大洞，毁掉了劳森的比赛。
事故发生后不到20分钟，该事件就已被记录、列入调查，随后又被裁定无需进一步处理。
当被《The Race》问及这一判罚时，劳森说：“对车队来说是好事（林德布拉德最终获得第七名），是的，显然我不会去抗议我的队友——但我不理解这个判罚，因为我被撞得非常重，我的底板都被撞出一个洞了。
“我当时正在转向入弯，给对方留出了空间。所以从我的角度来看，我不理解这个判罚，但可以说这对车队来说是好事。”
林德布拉德为这次碰撞向小红牛和劳森道歉，但也为这次事故提出了两个可以减轻责任的情况。
“那完全是一片混乱。我想就像你们在巴库几乎所有的安全车重启时看到的那样，一号弯会变得相当混乱，我不知道前方发生了什么，但管理得相当糟糕，车流没有聚拢在一起，”林德布拉德说。
“从我们所处的位置来看，我和埃斯特班，还有奥利（比尔曼），在直道上已经来回了大概三次；我们一遍遍地减速又重新出发。所以当时完全是一片混乱，赛车的电池也因此不在理想的工作窗口内。”
“每个人在一号弯都刹车刹得有点太晚，我本来准备对埃斯特班完成超越，但他在最后一刻变线——基本上就是在刹车时变线，所以我不得不采取避让动作，这意味着我的前轮稍微锁死，然后撞上了利亚姆。”
“所以很明显，我已经向他道歉了；我也向车队道歉了，因为这种事情不是你想要的，今天我们本来可能有两个车手进入积分区，但与此同时我们也接受了这个结果。”
林德布拉德是在刚刚完成比赛、还没有太多时间复盘这次事故的情况下说这番话的，但他表示，在安全车重启时处于车流中间的感觉“糟透了”。
“这次重启做得并不好。到最后应该是整个车队慢慢聚拢，然后大家同时出发，”林德布拉德说。
“所以我确信下周的车手简报会上会有人提出这个问题，我们也需要讨论一下，但说实话，两次重启都不太好。
“你得往前看几辆车，搞清楚发生了什么，但在这里我们要应对的事情实在太多了。到最后，那是一条两公里长的直道，轮胎是冷的，刹车是冷的，电池显然又是一个新问题。当大家不停地在走和停之间切换时，是相当危险的，我认为我们需要弄清楚原因。”
他的第一个可以减轻责任的因素——轮胎和刹车冰冷情况下艰难的重启——确实是相关的，但这是否应该让他免于任何处罚则非常值得怀疑。毕竟，对于受到处罚的科拉平托来说，这些因素同样存在。
至于奥康在刹车时移动的说法，实际情况似乎并非如此，奥康一直保持在劳森左侧的线路上。如果非要说的话，反倒是右侧的劳森横向移动，试图封堵奥康的线路。
林德布拉德给出了一个即兴的现场观点，不应该因此受到苛责，但令人费解的是，对于一起看起来证据确凿的事故——一名失控的车手因误判而猛烈撞上另一辆车——干事们为何会如此迅速地排除任何处罚。
干事们之所以基本没有处罚林德布拉德，是因为他们认为这起事故是前方科拉平托、加斯利和诺里斯相撞事故的直接后果。
“这起事故，加上科拉平托锁死刹车，引发了林德布拉德前方紧随的几辆车做出紧急刹车反应，”干事的裁决中写道。
“与此同时，林德布拉德的位置被左右两侧的赛车夹在中间。过弯时，林德布拉德与劳森发生了碰撞。
“在查看了涉事赛车的位置和移动情况后，干事们认定，这次碰撞主要是由于林德布拉德可用的空间受限，以及前方事故引发的连锁反应所致，而不是林德布拉德的任何行为或失误导致，因此不能认定他负有全部或主要责任。
当你回看事故画面时，这个解释对林德布拉德来说显得非常宽厚。加斯利、科拉平托和诺里斯的撞车发生在相当远的前方，在林德布拉德撞上劳森之前，奥孔和劳森似乎都没有做出任何有意义的躲避动作。
干事的报告对此只字未提——但也可能存在一条不成文的规则，即干事对队友之间碰撞的判罚，不如对不同车队车手之间的碰撞那样严厉。正如劳森自己所说：“我不会去抗议我的队友。”
如果干事们选择在赛后进行调查，小红牛显然会请求不予处罚。
但在评判这类事件时，赛车的颜色不应成为考量因素。
detailEn: The intra-team Racing Bulls collision at Formula 1’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix that wiped out Liam Lawson was surprisingly dismissed as needing no further action.

Franco Colapinto was handed a 10-second time penalty (converted into a five-place grid drop for the Malaysian Grand Prix) for spearing into his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris’s McLaren, but the stewards decided not to act on the collision that took place behind them.

While Ocon and Lawson were side-by-side in the Turn 1 braking zone, Lindblad ended up locking his brakes and running into Lawson in the sister car, punching a big hole in its floor and ruining Lawson’s race.
Within 20 minutes of the incident occurring, the incident had been noted, placed under investigation and then dismissed as needing no further action.

Asked about the ruling by The Race, Lawson said: “Great for the team [Lindblad went on to finish seventh], yeah, obviously I'm not going to go and protest my team-mate - but I don't understand it because I got hit so hard that it put a hole in my floor.
“I was just turning for the corner, giving the guy space. So where I'm sitting, I don't understand, but let's say it's great for the team.”
Lindblad apologised to Racing Bulls and Lawson for the clash but offered two mitigating circumstances for the incident.

“It was an absolute mess. I think as you see on almost all safety car restarts here in Baku it gets quite chaotic in Turn 1, I don't know what was happening at the front, but it was pretty poorly managed in the sense that the field wasn't bunched up,” Lindblad said.

“From where we were, me and Esteban, we'd gone - or Ollie [Bearman] - about three times on the straight; we'd sort of gone and braked and gone again. So it was complete chaos, the battery wasn't in a good window because of that.

“Everyone braked a little bit too late in Turn 1 and I was going to make the move on Esteban and he moved in the last minute - basically moved under braking, so [I] had to take avoiding action, which meant I locked the front slightly and I hit Liam.

“So obviously I've apologised to him already; I've apologised to the team because it's not something you want, because there could have been two of us in the points today, but also at the same time we take the result.”
Lindblad was speaking fresh from finishing the race with limited time to review the incident, but he says it was “terrible” in the middle of the train at the safety car restart.
“It wasn't a well-done restart. In the end it should be a bunched-up field that goes slowly, and then we all go at once,” Lindblad said.
“So I'm sure it will get raised at the briefing next week, and it's something we'll discuss, but honestly both restarts weren't very good.

“You're trying to look a few cars ahead to see what's going on, but there are so many things we're having to manage here. In the end, it's a 2km straight, tyres are cold, brakes are cold, batteries are obviously a new problem. When everyone's going-and-stopping it's pretty dangerous and I think we need to understand why.”

His first mitigating factor, a tricky restart on cold tyres and brakes, is certainly relevant, but whether that should absolve him of any penalty is highly questionable. Those were also factors applicable for the penalised Colapinto, after all.

As for Ocon moving under braking, this really doesn’t appear to be the case, with Ocon holding his line to the left of Lawson. If anything, it’s Lawson on the right who makes a move across to try to cover Ocon.

Lindblad shouldn’t be judged harshly for giving a fresh-from-the-moment opinion, but what’s baffling is why the stewards elected to quickly rule out any punishment for what appeared to be a clear-cut case of one out-of-control driver slamming into another with a misjudged move.
The stewards predominantly didn’t punish Lindblad because they believed the incident to be a direct consequence of the Colapinto/Gasly/Norris shunt ahead.
“That incident, together with Colapinto locking his brakes, triggered a braking reaction among the cars immediately ahead of Lindblad,” the stewards’ decision read.
“At the same time, Lindblad was positioned between cars on either side. During the corner, Lindblad made contact with Lawson.

“Having reviewed the positioning and movement of the cars involved, the stewards determined that the contact was primarily the result of the restricted space available to Lindblad and the chain reaction caused by the incident ahead, rather than any action or error for which Lindblad could be considered wholly or predominantly to blame.”

When you review the incident footage, that explanation feels incredibly generous to Lindblad. The Gasly/Colapinto/Norris crash happened far enough up the road that Ocon and Lawson didn’t appear to initiate any meaningful avoiding action before Lindblad went into Lawson.

The stewards' report makes no reference to it - but there could also be the unwritten rule of the stewards not judging team-mate collisions as harshly as collisions involving drivers from different teams. As Lawson himself said: “I'm not going to go and protest my team-mate.”
Had the stewards opted for a post-race investigation, Racing Bulls would have obviously requested no penalty.
But what colour the cars are shouldn’t be a factor when judging these incidents.
keyPointsZh: 科拉平托因撞上队友加斯利和诺里斯的迈凯伦被罚10秒，折算为马来西亚大奖赛退后五位发车
劳森表示不会抗议自己的队友，但不理解这一裁决
林德布拉德向车队和劳森道歉，并解释巴库安全车重启时一号弯通常非常混乱
keyPointsEn: Franco Colapinto received a 10-second penalty converted into a five-place grid drop in Malaysia for hitting team-mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris's McLaren
Lawson said he would not protest his own team-mate but does not understand the ruling
Lindblad apologised but noted that Turn 1 is chaotic on almost every safety car restart in Baku
